Subject: Invitation to Speak at [Conference Name]

Dear [Speaker Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to you on behalf of [Organization Name] to invite you to be a keynote speaker at our upcoming conference, [Conference Name], scheduled to take place on [Date] in [Location].

We have long admired your work in [Speaker's Field/Topic], particularly your recent insights on [Specific Topic or Book]. Your expertise and unique perspective would be an invaluable addition to our event. The theme of this year’s conference is "[Conference Theme]," and we believe your background aligns perfectly with our goal of exploring [Specific Aspect of Theme].

We would be honored to have you deliver a [Duration, e.g., 45-minute] keynote address followed by a brief Q&A session. In terms of engagement, we are pleased to offer a speaking fee of [Amount], along with coverage of all travel and accommodation expenses.

Please let us know if you are available and interested in this opportunity. We would be happy to discuss the details further at your convenience.

Thank you for considering our invitation.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Organization Name]
[Contact Information]
